task.question: What is the name of the championship held in Akron, Ohio in July 2026?
task.evidence: July 9–12: Kaulig Companies Championship at Firestone Country Club in Akron, Ohio – Zach Johnson
task.sonnet_answer: The 2026 U.S. Women's Open Championship, scheduled to be held at Firestone Country Club in Akron, Ohio in July 2026.
